get.description: This endpoint returns a list of your company's registered senders. It can be used to locate a `senderId`, which is a required parameter when [sending a sign request](https://signinc.readme.io/reference/send-sign-request).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of senders to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The total number of senders to return. Default 500. Maximum 500.

get.description: This endpoint returns list of teams. It can be used to locate a `teamId`, which can then be used to filter other API requests (e.g., [Get template](https://signinc.readme.io/reference/get-template) or [Get sign request](https://signinc.readme.io/reference/get-sign-request)).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of teams to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The total number of teams to return. Default 500. Maximum value is 500.

get.description: This endpoint returns a list of templates.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of templates to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The total number of templates to return. Default 500. Maximum value is 500.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: A filter that returns only templates with a specified status. Possible values are: `Draft`, `Active`, `Inactive`, `Disabled`. Case-insensitive. If an incorrect value is provided, then the filter will be ignored.

parameters.name: teamUuid
parameters.description: A filter that returns only templates associated with a specified `teamId`.

parameters.name: ownerUuid
parameters.description: A filter that returns only templates associated with a specified `ownerId`.

formType.description: Template type. Possible values are `Form` or `Document`

savedTime.description: The time the template was last saved

publishedTime.description: The time the template was last published

sequence.description: The sequence in which the sign role appears in our user interfaces and, if applicable, the sequence in which the sign role participates in a sign request.

get.description: This endpoint returns information for a specified template.

parameters.name: templateUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the template that should be returned.

status.description: The template status. Possible values are: `Draft`, `Active`, `Inactive`, `Disabled`

formType.description: The template type. Possible values are `Form` or `Document`

savedTime.description: The time the template was last saved

publishedTime.description: The time the template was last published

authType.description: The authentication method applied to the template. Possible values are: `No authentication`, `Email authentication`, `SMS authentication`, `OOB authentication`, `E2EE with email authentication`, `E2EE with SMS authentication`, `E2EE with OOB authentication`

sequence.description: The sequence in which the sign role appears in the UI and, if applicable, the order of signing

serverSecret.description: A base64-encoded string used for encryption key derivation

salt.description: A base64-encoded string used to salt key derivation

get.description: This endpoint returns a list of sign requests. It can be used to locate the `signrequestId` for a given sign request, which can then be used in other API requests (e.g., [Get sign request](https://signinc.readme.io/reference/get-sign-request), [Complete sign request](https://signinc.readme.io/reference/complete-sign-request), [Download files](https://signinc.readme.io/reference/download-files), [Download file URLs](https://signinc.readme.io/reference/download-file-urls), [Download file URL](https://signinc.readme.io/reference/download-file-url), [Cancel sign request](https://signinc.readme.io/reference/cancel-sign-request), or [Download audit trail](https://signinc.readme.io/reference/download-audit-trail)).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of sign requests to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The total number of sign requests to return. Default 500. Maximum value is 500.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: A filter that returns only sign requests with a specified status. Possible values are: `Draft`, `Sent`, `Completed`, `Declined`. Case-insensitive. If an incorrect value is provided, then the filter will be ignored.

parameters.name: teamUuid
parameters.description: A filter that returns only sign requests associated with a specified `teamId`.

parameters.name: senderUuid
parameters.description: A filter that returns only sign requests associated with a specified `senderId`.

parameters.name: ownerUuid
parameters.description: A filter that returns only sign requests associated with a specified `ownerId`.

formType.description: The type of the sign request. Possible values: `Form`, `Document`

sequence.description: The sequence in which the sign role appears in our user interfaces and, if applicable, the sequence in which the sign role participates in a sign request.

savedTime.description: The time the sign request was last saved

get.description: This endpoint returns information for a specified sign request.

parameters.name: signrequestUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the sign request that should be returned.

status.description: Current status of the sign request

authType.description: The authentication method applied to the sign request. Example values include: `No authentication`, `Email authentication`, `SMS authentication`, `OOB authentication`, `E2EE with email authentication`, `E2EE with SMS authentication`, `E2EE with OOB authentication`.

serverSecret.description: A base64-encoded server-side string used for key derivation

salt.description: A base64-encoded salt value used for key derivation

roleUuid.description: Role UUID associated with the field

isMasked.description: If true, field data is masked in UI

get.description: This endpoint returns a sign request weblink for an authenticated participant.

parameters.name: participantUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the participant for whom weblink should be returned.

get.description: This endpoint returns an embeddable code snippet for a specified participant.

parameters.name: participantUuid
parameters.description: UUID of the participant for whom the embeddable code snippet should be returned.

embeddableCode.description: An embeddable code snippet specific to a given participant

post.description: This endpoint sends a new sign request using a specified template. Only active templates can be used to send a sign request.

parameters.name: templateUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the template that should be used to send the sign request.

senderUuid.description: The UUID of the sender that should be identified as the sender of the sign request.

clientSecret.description: A base64-encoded client-side encryption secret. Required when the template uses one of the following auth types: `E2EE with email authentication`, `E2EE with SMS authentication`, `E2EE with OOB authentication`.

sendInvitations.description: Whether or not invitation emails should be sent to participants.

emailSubject.description: The custom subject line for participant invitation emails.

emailMessage.description: The custom message body for participant invitation emails.

participants.description: A list of participants for the sign request. One for each signing role.

name.description: The full name of the signing participant.

email.description: The email address of the signing participant.

roleUuid.description: The UUID of the role the participant is signing as.

salt.description: Base64-encoded salt used for key derivation

post.description: This endpoint reverts a sign request back to the `Draft` status, deletes any associated [FieldData](https://signinc.readme.io/reference/fielddata) records, and invalidates any associated participant links. Only sign requests in the `Sent` state can be canceled.

parameters.name: signrequestUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the sign request that should be canceled.

authType.description: The authentication method applied to the sign request. Example values: `No authentication`, `Email authentication`, `SMS authentication`, `OOB authentication`, `E2EE with email authentication`, `E2EE with SMS authentication`, `E2EE with OOB authentication`

serverSecret.description: A base64-encoded string used for encryption key derivation

salt.description: Base64-encoded string used to salt encryption keys

post.description: This endpoint is used to complete a sign request for a specified participant.

parameters.name: participantUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the participant completing the sign request.

clientSecret.description: A base64-encoded client-side encryption secret. Required when the sign request uses one of the following auth types: `E2EE with email authentication`, `E2EE with SMS authentication`, `E2EE with OOB authentication`.

sendCompletionEmail.description: Whether or not completion emails should be sent to participants. Defaults to `FALSE`. Ignored unless the subject participant is the last participant to complete the sign request.

emailNextParticipant.description: Whether or not to send a signature request email to the next participant. Defaults to `FALSE`. Ignored unless the sign request has multiple participants signing sequentially.

fieldData.description: An array of [FieldData](https://signinc.readme.io/reference/fielddata) objects required to complete a sign request for a specified `participantId`. Should contain an object for each of the subject participant’s required fields. Each [FieldData](https://signinc.readme.io/reference/fielddata) object should contain only one of the following: (1) `fieldChoiceId`, (2) `imageContent` and `imageMimetype` OR (3) `value` as defined below.

fieldUuid.description: The UUID associated with the field data being provided.

fieldChoiceUuid.description: If the field type is `select` or `checkbox`, then provide the applicable `fieldChoiceId`.

imageContent.description: If the field type is `signature` or `initials` AND an image is being provided, then this property should be provided along with the `imageMimetype` property. If an image isn’t being provided, then the `value` property should be used instead. Important: Image content should be Base64 encoded with only the image content (i.e., without mimetype). Mimetype should be sent in the corresponding property below. That is, for example, instead of `data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KG`, this property should only include `iVBORw0KG...`.

imageMimetype.description: If the field type is `signature` or `initials` AND an image is being provided, then this property should be provided along with the `imageContent` property. If an image isn’t being provided, then the `value` property should be used instead.

value.description: If the field type is not `select`, `signature`, or `initials`, then a string value should be provided for this property.

formType.description: The type of the sign request. Possible values: `Form`, `Document`

sequence.description: The sequence in which the sign role appears in our user interfaces and, if applicable, the sequence in which the sign role participates in a sign request

fieldUuid.description: The UUID of the field for which data was created

imageContent.description: The Base64 encoded image content if the field type is `signature` or `initials` AND an image was provided

imageMimetype.description: The uploaded image mimetype if the field type is `signature` or `initials`

authType.description: The authentication method applied to the sign request. Possible values are: `No authentication`, `Email authentication`, `SMS authentication`, `OOB authentication`, `E2EE with email authentication`, `E2EE with SMS authentication`, `E2EE with OOB authentication`

serverSecret.description: A base64-encoded string used for encryption key derivation

salt.description: A base64-encoded string used to salt key derivation

savedTime.description: The time the sign request was last saved

roleUuid.description: The sign role UUID associated with this field

required.description: Whether a field is required for completion

isMasked.description: Whether a field is masked. If `true`, FieldData will be rendered as a series of asterisks in documents and viewable only by the sender of the sign request.

reference.description: A user-provided value that can be used to identify field and fieldData in API responses.

post.description: This endpoint returns files as Base64 encoded strings for a specified sign request. It will only return files for completed sign requests.

parameters.name: signrequestUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the sign request for which files should be returned.

unlock.description: If this parameter is true, then `clientSecret` is required and encrypted files will be decrypted before downloading.

clientSecret.description: A base64-encoded client-side encryption secret. Required when `unlock` is true. Used to decrypt encrypted files.

post.description: This endpoint returns temporary file URLs for a specified sign request. It will only return URLs for completed sign requests.

parameters.name: signrequestUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the sign request for which temporary file URLs should be returned.

url.description: A temporary URL for downloading a file

post.description: This endpoint returns a temporary URL for a specified fileId. It will only return URLs for completed sign requests.

parameters.name: fileUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the file for which a temporary URL should be returned.

post.description: This endpoint returns a PDF audit trail as a Base64 encoded string for a specified sign request.

parameters.name: signrequestUuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the sign request for which an audit trail should be returned.
